The '''Hive Wars''' was a period of [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] history that occurred prior to their discovery of space travel. Struggling to exist on an insect-based diet on [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]], which was plagued by intense solar radiation from [[Ku'Bakai]], each Kubaz clan maintained its own hive of insects for food, but some were still lacking in sustenance. Shortages and raids sparked all-out wars between neighboring clans. Slowly killing off the Kubaz, the Hive Wars were ended with the discovery of [[Insecticulture]], which allowed the Kubaz geneticists to alter the coloration of an insect, color-coding them according to ownership.
